**My pick: the Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable Wireless Charging Stand with Qi2 25W, $129.99.** Macworld gave it an Editors' Choice award. I couldn't open the WIRED roundup, so this rests on the Macworld review alone.

**Why it stands out (per Macworld):**
- It charges at up to 25W (Qi2.2) for the iPhone. The Apple Watch and AirPods pads are each rated at 5W, and the Watch module supports fast charging.
- The charging pad is adjustable with a 160-degree viewing angle. Macworld calls it the tallest and most adjustable foldable 3-in-1 the reviewer tested.
- It folds flat for travel.
- It includes a 45W power adapter with US, UK and EU plugs.

**Downside:** It weighs 399g, more than twice as much as the smaller Kuxiu X40 and ESR foldables. If you want the lightest travel option, those are better.

**Where to buy the Satechi:**
- [Satechi](https://satechi.com/products/3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-with-qi2-25w)
- [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GNRSY36V)
- [Best Buy](https://www.bestbuy.com/product/satechi-3-in-1-qi2-25w-fast-wireless-charging-stand-magnetic-foldable-for-iphone-apple-watch-airpods-space-black/J3GWC4C8TW)
- [B&H](https://www.bhphotovideo.com/c/product/1960497-REG/satechi_st_q25f31c_ea_3_in_1_foldable_qi2_25w.html)
- [Walmart](https://www.walmart.com/ip/Satechi-3-in-1-Qi2-Wireless-Charging-Station-25W-Fast-Magnetic-Charger-Foldable-Stand-iPhone-Apple-Watch-AirPods-45W-USB-C-Adapter-Included-Space-Bla/19875453032)

**Cheaper or lighter alternatives:** Macworld lists the ESR Foldable at $99.99 and the Kuxiu X40 at $79.99. A deal site, [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/lab/V1/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand), says code PARTNER18 takes $17.99 off the ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1 (Qi2.2, 25W) at ESR's US store, bringing it to about $82. I haven't verified that code or confirmed it's the same model Macworld priced at $99.99, so check the price at checkout.

**Choosing:** Get the Satechi if the stand will mostly sit on a desk and you want the best adjustability. Get the ESR or Kuxiu if you want something lighter to travel with or want to spend less.
